# Where to find Random Camp Encounters in Fallout 76

With thanks to Garust, Lady Emma, Eli - The Thing, Cassi, Mette, Sanne, Jamie MachinegunGOGO, and Thaang.

There are 6 types of random encounters in-game and each encounter type has its own set of spawn locations.

Enemy, NPC, Settler or, Raider vs Enemy, NPC, Settler or, Raider. Can be useful for farming meat for Carnivore food buffs.

Traveling Merchants.

Corpses containing plans and Mr. Squeeze who sells the Lemonade and Hard Lemonade plans.

Tamable pets, set scenes with an NPC and the Insult Bot.

**Travel**

An NPC that moves back and forth along a small route, generally vendors of some kind.

**Whitesprings Assault**

Enemy vs Whitespring Robots.

**Special Mention Encounters**

Skyline Valley

It takes 18 minutes for a random encounter location to refresh once all players have left the cell.

There is a condition set on all encounter spawn locations “Do all before repeating”. This means that as long as you stay on the same server and do not refresh or rebuild it, each location will go through the entire spawn list before starting at the top again.

Some encounters have region checks and won't spawn in certain areas.

Some encounters will only spawn in cells that have been nuked. If you want a better chance at finding these encounters, go to a private custom server and turn **__ON__** "Nuked Flora & Creatures". This will make the server think that you just dropped a nuke and will activate the additional encounters.

Some encounters have a space check. For example, if there is not enough room for a mega sloth vs super mutants to run through their animations, they will not spawn in certain locations.

All encounters have a 100% chance to spawn, however, there may be a delay of up to 1 min before something will spawn. If you are checking encounters on public servers and nothing spawns then it's possible that another player has walked through the cell and activated the spawn so that location will be on cool down.

### **__Camp__**

__Camp__

There are a total of 37 different Camp encounter types and 49 Camp spawn locations.

If you are farming these locations for the Travelling Vendors or Wandering Storyteller, check your HUD as you get closer to the location, as they show as a non-hostile yellow dot.

**Map of all** __Camp__ **spawn locations**

__Useful or Interesting encounters__

For a full list of encounters, please refer to the list __here__.

**Traveling Vendors**

There are two ways that you can farm these NPCs for their inventory. Both ways require someone else to hold the NPC for you.

Bring one toon in, check the NPCs inventory, leave the server, switch to another toon, check the NPCs inventory, rinse, and repeat.

OR

Bring your toon in, check the NPCs' inventory, leave the server, wait 8 minutes, and then bring that same toon in and re-check the NPCs' inventory and their items for sale should have refreshed.

**Armour Trader**

Sells non-legendary armour and underarmour.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Clinic Trader**

Sells Disease Cure and Healing Salve recipes based on the region that you find them in. For example, if you find the trader in the Cranberry Bog then they will spawn the Healing Salve and Disease Cure Cranberry Bog recipes.

A player under level 25 will have a 100% chance for the healing salve plans to spawn and a player over the level of 25 will have a 50% chance for the healing salve plans to spawn.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Chem Trader**

Sells chems, chem recipes, and junk.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Clothing Trader**

Sells the same apparel as the Vendor Responder Bot.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Food Trader**

Sells cooked dishes and raw ingredients.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Miscellaneous Trader**

Sells a mix of everything from common clothes, food, drink, ammo, and junk.

Vendor also sells holiday wrapping paper, mole miner pails, and mystery candy when the events are running/active.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

**Weapons Trader**

Sells all the bow and compound bow plans and mods without a rep check.

A full list of inventory and % drop rate can be found __here__.

You will need to sneak up to really appreciate this encounter because as soon as they see you, they will attack you. Also, suggest turning your sound up or turning sub-titles on.

**Felton Reed**

### **__Easiest locations to server hop__**

__Easiest locations to server hop__

__Toxic Valley__

**Woods Estate**

From the spawn-in point, turn NE and walk forward. You should be able to see a patch of alive trees in the distance. Keep walking forward towards the trees and stop at the tent.

__Forest__

**Anchor Farm**

From the fast travel point, turn NW and follow the road down. Walk past the orange truck/ute on your left and the 90 sign on your right. At the 90 sign, turn West and walk forward.

**Overlook Cabin**

From the spawn-in point, turn around until you face East. Walk/jump up the hill until you see the tent.

__Ash Heap__

**Camden Park**

From the fast travel point, turn and face West. Run forward and follow the river along on the left-hand side, keep following the river around until you see the tent.

There is also a potential rare baseball bat spawn __here.__

**Mount Blair Trainyard**

From the fast travel point, turn and face South. Walk over and stop on the train tracks in front of you. Turn West and follow the train tracks until you see the top of a green tent on your right. The spawn is at the tent.

__Savage Divide South__

**Blackwater Mine**

From the spawn-in point, turn SE and look up the mountain. The spawn location is under the billboard in the distance.

**Yellow Sandy's Still**

Head towards the icon.

__Savage Divide North__

**Metal Dome**

From the fast travel point, run straight forward and follow the path/cliff face around on the left. Keep following the cliff face around for a little, until you see a picnic table and some tents on your right.

**Sacrament**

From the spawn in location, turn East and walk straight until you get to the trees at the top of the small hill in front of you. At the top, turn North and walk forward, veering to the right so you end up at the top of the mountain.

__The Mire__

**Gnarled Shallows**

From the spawn-in point, run straight toward the map icon/large tree in the middle of the water. Once you get to the tree, turn and follow the river North. Stick to the left side of the river bank and keep following it. Look to your left as you are following the river bank up and you will see the top of a tent.

Keep following the river bank up for a fixed spawn of 3 to 4 more Anglers.

**Tanagra Town**

There is a fixed spawn for a Mega Sloth at the base of the tree.

From the fast travel point, walk forward until you are standing on the edge of the hole that the tree is in. Follow the edge around until you see some buildings. The camp encounter is out the front of the shed, closest to the bus stop.

__Cranberry Bog__

**Forward Station Alpha**

From the spawn-in point, turn and line up between East and Superior Sunset Farm map marker. Run forward until you drop down into one of the trenches. Follow the trench down and the encounter location will be on your left.

**Lost Home**

Head towards the icon.

There is a bobblehead in the blue container, on the roof, in front of the two chairs on the roof plus salt, pepper, and spices.
